content: TUMFTM racetrack-database and laptime-simulation are LGPL-3.0; track geometry is OSM-derived and processed, and centerlines are smoothed and may not be centered. OpenF1 says it is unofficial and does not claim ownership of F1 data; software/API openness is not blanket permission for underlying event data. Preserve notices and review source/data terms before redistributing artifacts. Sources: https://github.com/TUMFTM/racetrack-database ; https://github.com/TUMFTM/laptime-simulation ; https://openf1.org/
